Question ID: STAT_U01_L02_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.STQ.1

A dataset records only the number of books each student read last month. What type of data structure is this?

answer.text: Univariate, because one variable is recorded for each student

feedback.text: The one variable is number of books read.

answer.text: Bivariate, because many students are included

feedback.text: Many cases do not mean there are two variables.

answer.text: Categorical bivariate, because books have categories

feedback.text: The dataset records a count, not book categories.

answer.text: Neither, because books are not numerical

feedback.text: The number of books is a numerical count.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U01_L02_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.STQ.1

A study records each student's hours of sleep and reaction time. What display is most appropriate for exploring the relationship?

answer.text: Scatterplot

feedback.text: A scatterplot shows the relationship between two numerical variables.

answer.text: Bar chart

feedback.text: A bar chart compares categories, but both variables are numerical.

answer.text: Histogram

feedback.text: A histogram displays one numerical variable, not a relationship.

answer.text: Two-way table

feedback.text: Two-way tables are usually for two categorical variables.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U01_L02_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.STQ.2

A table records grade level and preferred lunch option for each student. What kind of data relationship can be studied?

answer.text: A relationship between two numerical variables

feedback.text: Neither variable is a measured numerical quantity.

answer.text: A distribution of one numerical variable

feedback.text: There are two variables, and both are categorical.

answer.text: A relationship between two categorical variables

feedback.text: Grade level and lunch option are both categories.

answer.text: No relationship, because categories cannot be compared

feedback.text: Categorical variables can be compared using counts or relative frequencies.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U01_L02_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.STQ.1

Which display best fits one numerical variable such as commute time in minutes?

answer.text: Two-way table

feedback.text: A two-way table is usually for two categorical variables.

answer.text: Segmented bar graph

feedback.text: A segmented bar graph compares categorical relative frequencies.

answer.text: Scatterplot

feedback.text: A scatterplot requires two numerical variables.

answer.text: Dot plot

feedback.text: A dot plot can show the distribution of one numerical variable.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U01_L02_GP_Q05

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.STQ.2

Why is favorite sport and number of hours practiced per week a bivariate dataset?

answer.text: Because the sport names are longer than the numbers

feedback.text: Text length is not what makes data bivariate.

answer.text: Because two variables are recorded for each person

feedback.text: Each person has a sport category and a numerical practice-time value.

answer.text: Because every dataset with students is bivariate

feedback.text: A dataset can include many students and still have only one variable.

answer.text: Because all sports data are numerical

feedback.text: Favorite sport is categorical, while practice time is numerical.
